title: ENERGY FUELS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Energy Fuels Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026, disclosing that board members J. Birks Bovaird and Alexander G. Morrison will not seek re-election at the June 24, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The filing states the departures were not due to any disagreement with the company on operations, policies, or practices.
key_points: J. Birks Bovaird and Alexander G. Morrison notified the Board they will not seek re-election at the June 24, 2026 Annual Meeting
The departures were not due to any disagreement with the Company on matters related to operations, policies, or practices
Energy Fuels Inc. is a uranium and rare earth elements company incorporated in Ontario, Canada
Common shares trade on NYSE American (ticker: UUUU) and Toronto Stock Exchange (ticker: EFR)
